text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the spring Tenno Sho. While it stands as our race goal, it's also a race Tamamo Cross wants to win for her father.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knowing Tamamo Cross runs for her family, her fans offer their heartfelt support. Deeply moved by the sheer warmth in the world, she heads to the gate.
